nodes.text: #STLUCIA: St.Lucia are presently in the typical flu season with notable increases in respiratory illnesses among the population. It is experiencing peak travel and visitor influx, and notes increases in Influenza A, cases of respiratory syncytial virus and COVID- 19 variants.
